commentary.text: 90+10' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+9' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) was quite harsh and Cesar Soto Grado didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+9' Joselu (Real Madrid) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Arda Guler, but Alvaro Valles displays great awareness to stop him.
90+8' Poor challenge! Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) is penalised for tripping and Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle.
90+7' Cesar Soto Grado shows a yellow card to Ferland Mendy (Real Madrid) for his blatant foul.
90+5' What was Maximo Perrone (Las Palmas) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.

41' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Las Palmas will have a goal kick.
40' Some great controlled play and passing from Real Madrid. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.

36' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the roof of the net, but Alvaro Valles shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.

34' Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas) latches onto a short pass just on the edge of the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper but comes back off the crossbar. Close! The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid will have a goal kick.
32' PENALTY APPEAL after Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.

18' Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle and signals a foul after Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) brought his opponent down. There is a free kick near the sideline to Real Madrid.

17' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Madrid.

14' Toni Kroos sends the free kick into the box. Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) outjumps the defence to win the header, but completely mistimes the ball and sends it well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Las Palmas.
13' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas). That's a free kick to Real Madrid.
12' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
12' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger. Real Madrid force a corner. They send men into the box.
11' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) jumps into a tackle and Cesar Soto Grado signals a foul. Real Madrid win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
11' Real Madrid take a short corner kick.
11' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, Real Madrid are going to take it.
10' A clumsy foul by Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) and Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle. Real Madrid earn a free kick.
8' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) tries to find Vinicius Junior, but he puts too much power on the pass.
5' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) picks up a yellow card.
5' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the left post. Alvaro Valles is alert and denies him with a nice save.
3' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) finds enough space to climb high and plants a header way over the bar. What a poor effort. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid will have a goal kick.
